text:
ari: quick question — we're rolling out region-priority routing for Gold customers next week. how do we expose the fallback chain in the console so oncall and SREs can see when requests downgrade model variants? need suggestions on telemetry + sampling.

jordan: show the evaluated routing headers in the request trace. add a 'routing decisions' panel that lists policy, matched route, and fallback sequence. simple list + compact timeline.

priya: agreed. also need a metric for 'fallback_rate' per model variant and per region. alert when >2% for 5m. tie to the rollout so PMs can pause.

matt: for sampling: 100% of errors, 10% of slow requests, 1% of normal successes by default. admin override per-customer.

ari: can we include the exact header we use so customers can replicate locally? example header:

```
X-Redwood-Routing: region=eu;priority=gold;policy=latency;route=eu-a;fallback=eu-b,eu-c;variant=faster-quant
```

jordan: nice. in the trace view we should render a tiny waterfall: route selection -> selected model variant -> fallback trigger(s) -> final response. tooltips with token-level latency and the header blob.

priya: ux ask for the rollout console: heatmap by region of fallback_rate and top 5 prompts with highest fallback incidence. link to the eval prompt set that caused a regression.

ops-bot: deploy-bot posted: region-priority-routing v1 deploy started in eu-west at 2026-03-15T12:40Z :rocket:

matt: billing question — if Gold routes to a cheaper variant during congestion, do we bill at Gold rate or variant rate? this affects customer invoices.

ari: short-term: bill by customer tier (Gold) for predictability. long-term: add opt-in variant-level billing and show it in the usage UI. update docs accordingly.

priya: let's also add an audit header in logs: `X-Redwood-Routing-Decision` with the final decision id so ops can search traces. surface that in the console side panel.

kevin: i'll wire sampling flags into the telemetry pipeline and add a feature flag for increased sampling for hot customers. i'll post PR.

jordan: i'll prototype the panel layout (compact timeline + header blob + fallback list). aiming for a mock by EOD. cc @ari @priya

matt: consider persisting last-N routing headers per session for debugging, but limit to 100 entries and scrub PII by default.

priya: scrub PII by default, full header retention only for admins and with explicit consent. add a privacy toggle in the console.

ari: action items recap: jordan -> prototype panel, kevin -> telemetry + sampling PR, priya -> alerts + privacy rules, matt -> billing doc + retention proposal, ari -> update console docs and rollout checklist. :thumbsup: 

kevin: started a draft telemetry naming proposal: `redwood.routing.fallback_rate`, `redwood.routing.selected_variant`, `redwood.routing.decision_latency`. will link PR once ready.

jordan: one more thought — expose a condensed 'routing header' string in the search index so SREs can filter traces like `routing:region=eu priority=gold fallback>0`. low-cardinality so search stays fast.

ari: perfect. thanks everyone — i'll consolidate into the rollout ticket and ping infra for quotas/billing follow-up.

kevin: 👍 will follow up with PR link.

ops-bot: note: canary traffic percentage currently set to 10% for eu-west for region-priority routing.

ari: cool, closing this thread. if anything urgent, ping me.
